integrity: Analytic proof supplies all-dimensional lower and upper bounds. A finite linear-program checker only corroborates dimensions three through six; no independent mathematical audit.
limitations: Real-linear scalar Lipschitz operators on Euclidean cross-polytope vertices plus all edge midpoints; no claims about all boundary points, general Banach targets or optimizer uniqueness.
title: Sharp simultaneous Lipschitz extension from cross-polytope vertices to all edge midpoints
